purpose: Round 3 of the isolated object-first visual-direction experiment: cross-family stress test (12 new hobby families, several deliberately hard: cinema, AI, road trip, pets) plus a deliberate composition/lighting diversity router to test whether object-first develops a new sameness problem (warm golden light + cozy room + centered object + sparkles). Uses the real, unmodified D4 global style (global_style_v1.json, read only, never written) plus a temporary experiment-only object-first policy via compileHobbyPrompt's existing experimentOverride mechanism. Does NOT modify any production file, the production queue, launch-gate files, or quarantine status. Not persisted into production.

cinema.note: No exact 'cinema' ID exists; closest generic match (title 'Movies').

board games.note: exact generic match (title 'Board Games', not a sub-style variant)

composition_diversity_router.note: All 12 of the required composition archetypes used exactly once across the set, deliberately assigned to avoid convergence on a single default treatment.

decision_gate_options: A. Object-first as primary - default visual language, humans only as exceptions
B. Hybrid - object-first for selected archetype families, human-led D4 remains equally important
C. Object-first limited - niche/fallback lane only
hard_guardrails: exactly 12 images this round, no rerolls unless technically unusable (corrupt/undecodable file)
no production file writes, no production queue changes, no launch-gate file changes, no quarantine changes
no auto-scaling/auto-promotion/permanent architecture build after the test
no fal.ai, no other image model, no reference images, no image-to-image
